edits.name: w5p-offer-1
edits.prompt: The same sloth soldier as in the picture, exactly the same painted storybook style, the same soft painted shading and the same thin dark brown outlines, on the same flat plain grey background. The same pale grey-beige fur, the same face and the same rumpled olive green uniform. Now, in place of the cap, he holds out a folded olive green wool army blanket in both paws, offering it kindly and shyly, leaning forward a little. The blanket has one badly darned patch sewn on with big crooked stitches. Side view facing right, whole body in frame. One sloth only.
